description: Two voltage-controlled amplifiers that can also invert, with their two outputs and a third input summed to a mix jack

params.text: Sets the gain of the first amplifier: silent at the centre, rising to unity at the clockwise end and to unity inverted at the counter-clockwise end
Sets the gain of the second amplifier: silent at the centre, rising to unity at the clockwise end and to unity inverted at the counter-clockwise end
Sets how much of the auxiliary input reaches the mix output, and starts at zero
Sets the level of the mix output, and starts at zero, so that jack is silent until this is turned up
Sets how long the accent envelope takes to fall away after each pulse

inputs.text: The audio input into the first amplifier
The audio input into the second amplifier
Multiplies the first amplifier's gain: 5V leaves the knob as it is, 0V closes the amplifier, 10V doubles it and a negative voltage flips the sign
Multiplies the second amplifier's gain: 5V leaves the knob as it is, 0V closes the amplifier, 10V doubles it and a negative voltage flips the sign
An extra signal that reaches the mix output only, at a level set by its own knob; it does not pass through either amplifier
A pulse above 1V fires the accent envelope, which lifts the first amplifier's gain from half to full and lets it fall back; it reaches the second amplifier nowhere

outputs.text: The first audio input multiplied by the first amplifier's gain
The second audio input multiplied by the second amplifier's gain
The two amplifier outputs and the auxiliary signal added together and scaled by the mix level

notes: both gain knobs are at the centre and the mix level is at zero when the module is added, so nothing comes out of any of the three outputs until something is turned up
while a cable is in the accent input the first amplifier runs at half its gain between pulses, so patching an accent makes that channel quieter until the first pulse arrives
the four lamps in each amplifier block show the sign of that channel's audio against the sign of its gain setting, one of the four lit at a time

inputs.2:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 5V.
inputs.3:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 5V.
inputs.5:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
